reviews.author: Shanu Hakkim
reviews.text:
I’ve had a great experience training with Lince at Champion Gym. He is highly professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely committed to helping clients achieve their fitness goals. His workout plans are well-structured, challenging, and tailored to individual needs, which makes every session effective and engaging.

Lince is also very motivating and supportive, always pushing you to do your best while ensuring proper form and safety. His positive attitude and dedication make a big difference, especially on days when motivation is low.

I highly recommend Lince to anyone looking for a skilled and reliable trainer at Champion Gym. Training with him has been both enjoyable and rewarding.

reviews.author: Manogna M.L.
reviews.text: I came across Champions Gym on Google when looking for gyms in Karama. This gym, tucked away in a quiet corner, above Viva Supermarket is a fun and bustling space for your workouts. The gym fee is nominal and they have good offers for longer-term memberships. The gym is well maintained and has all the essential equipment, a sauna, swimming pool, and they also conduct classes like aerobics, yoga, and boxing. The gym is run by Mr Binu Dasan who has won several awards for bodybuilding and has witnessed many transformation stories. The Trainers—Aryan and Rashid—are friendly and take proper care in recommending workout regimes based on your body types and fitness levels. They conduct fun cardio sessions and also guide you with your regular workouts. Personal training with any of them would be a bonus as many people have achieved impressive results. If you’re looking for a gym around Karama, I would happily recommend Champions!
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you so much for your valuable comments and recommendation much appreciated 🙏
